timeline.summary: Ajanta Pharma reported US FDA inspection at Paithan facility concluded with Form-483 and 5 observations.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,421.64 Cr (+21.5% YoY), net profit ₹266.7 Cr (+18.4% YoY).
Ajanta Pharma Limited uploaded earnings call audio recording from 5th May 2026 at 4:30 PM via its website under Q4-FY2026.

Ajanta Pharma Limited, via Sr. VP & Company Secretary **Gaurang Shah** and **Chinubhai Shah**, announced an **Analyst/Institutional Investor Conference** on **May 29, 2026**, at Grand Hyatt Santacruz.
Ajanta Pharma Limited, via Sr. VP & Company Secretary Gaurang Shah, revised its investor meet schedule to 29-May-26 (360 ONE Capital) and 08-Jun-26 (ICICI Securities).
